jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Build and run AI services & platforms.

You will work with Python and cloud tooling.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Degree in computer science or a related field.
  • Several years of experience in platform engineering or backend development.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and infrastructure as code.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
• Be part of a small example team building services for fictional customers
  • Work with an international and growing team
  • Use modern hardware and tools
